corrections_established: Addgene #185680 is pPW3758, CMVd3-HsIRE1-HaloTag, deposited by the Peter Walter laboratory. It is a human ERN1/IRE1 construct and is neither a plant vector nor a prime editing vector. Every claim in this project that #185680 is pRGEB57 was wrong.
pRGEB57 does not appear anywhere in the Addgene plant prime editing catalogue. Its existence as a deposited plasmid is unsupported.
The vector deposited from Li J et al. 2023 Plant Commun is ePE2, Addgene #202029, deposited by Pengcheng Wei.
The Yiping Qi rice prime editor is pYPQ166-OsPE2, Addgene #141080 (Mol Plant 2020), not pYPQ140, which is a gRNA entry vector.
Reference 25 is confirmed as Nat Plants 2025;11(2):191-205, matching the correction already applied.
